_meta.description: Griha Colour Palette Database. Add new palettes here. The palette-engine.js reads this file and requires no code changes to add new palettes.
_meta.instructions: Each palette must have: id, name, zones[], room_types[], swatches[], vastu_rationale, style_tags[], vendors[]

palettes.name: Warm Earthen
palettes.description: Rich terracotta, warm tawny brown, and soft cream — rooted in Indian vernacular architecture.
palettes.vastu_rationale: Earth tones anchor the SW zone's stability principle. These shades mirror the earth element that governs Nairutya direction.
palettes.science_rationale: Warm neutrals lower perceived room temperature psychologically and promote feelings of security — ideal for master bedrooms.
palettes.wallpaper_suggestion: Subtle linen or grasscloth texture wallpaper on one accent wall. Avoid bold prints — texture only.

palettes.name: Sage Serenity
palettes.description: Soft sage greens, botanical moss, and deep forest — bringing the calm of nature indoors.
palettes.vastu_rationale: Green and its tones align with the water-and-growth energy of the N and NE zones. Supports Kubera's abundance principle.
palettes.science_rationale: Green is the colour wavelength the human eye processes with least effort, reducing mental fatigue — ideal for study rooms and NE living rooms.
palettes.wallpaper_suggestion: Botanical print wallpaper — single accent wall. Large-leaf monstera or palm print in deep green on light ground.

palettes.name: Terracotta Dawn
palettes.description: Burnt clay, spiced orange, and ancient ochre — the colours of old Rajasthan and Chettinad homes.
palettes.vastu_rationale: Fire tones energise the SE Agni zone. Orange and terracotta amplify the fire element's qualities of energy, heat, and transformation.
palettes.science_rationale: Warm orange hues increase alertness and stimulate appetite — highly suited to kitchens and east-facing dining rooms.
palettes.wallpaper_suggestion: Geometric tile print or hand-block print wallpaper — traditional Indian motifs in burnt orange and terracotta.

palettes.name: Blue Hour
palettes.description: Deep indigo, twilight blue, and soft silver — bringing the serenity of the evening sky indoors.
palettes.vastu_rationale: Blue and indigo tones support the water element of the N and W zones. Particularly effective for Varuna-governed west-facing rooms.
palettes.science_rationale: Blue light wavelengths suppress cortisol and promote relaxation — making blue tones appropriate for bedrooms and study spaces.
palettes.wallpaper_suggestion: Textured linen wallpaper in off-white — let the paint do the colour work. Avoid busy prints.

palettes.name: Cloud White Collection
palettes.description: A curated range of whites — from cool chalk to warm ivory — for a timeless, light-maximising interior.
palettes.vastu_rationale: White and off-white tones are universally compatible across all Vastu zones. Especially important for the Brahmasthan (central area) and NE zone.
palettes.science_rationale: White reflects the most light of any colour, maximising the use of natural light — critical in Indian apartment designs where natural light is limited.
palettes.wallpaper_suggestion: Subtle embossed or textured white wallpaper — damask or linen weave pattern for depth without colour.
